question: How do divine and human years relate?
premises: A god day-night is a human year
Three hundred sixty human years make a god year
inference: The verse equates divine and human time through a fixed ratio.
uncertainties: Exact scope of nṝṇāṃ versus mānuṣāṇāṃ
plain_english: The day-night of the gods is a year for humans; by three hundred and sixty, the year of men becomes a god-year.
